question: How many hours elapsed since the first time patient 10021487 received a rbc, pleural lab test on this hospital visit?
sql_query: SELECT 24 * ( strftime('%J','2116-12-31 00:00:00') - strftime('%J', labevents.charttime) ) FROM labevents WHERE labevents.itemid IN ( SELECT d_labitems.itemid FROM d_labitems WHERE d_labitems.label = 'RBC, Pleural' ) AND labevents.hadm_id IN ( SELECT admissions.hadm_id FROM admissions WHERE admissions.subject_id = 10021487 AND admissions.dischtime IS NULL ) ORDER BY labevents.charttime ASC LIMIT 1
